tools.name: find_pros
tools.description: Find home and business service companies (garage door, locksmith, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, appliance and other trades) that cover a US ZIP code and take online bookings. Returns up to 5 companies, each with a booking_id.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: For one company from find_pros: what it does and the days and time windows open for booking.

tools.name: book_visit
tools.description: Book a visit with a company from find_pros. Only when the customer clearly asked to book, using their own name, phone and address. Confirm the company, day and time window with the customer first. The company confirms by text or a call.
